scoring.unit_hit: a top10 unique published source citation covers the complete expected function span and contains its verified function body
scoring.precision: unique published citation item with >=1 complete expected function and its body / all unique published citation items in top10; no items=0; macro question/family averages
scoring.recall: unique expected function units fully covered / declared expected units for this code-location question
scoring.rank: first relevant returned evidence reciprocal rank and hit@10
scoring.not_scored: EX15/16 unknown/foreign questions have no exhaustive source relevance set; only ontology-intent scope and source integrity are observed
scoring.limits: closed-world function-finding tasks; not exhaustive behavior/policy relevance or generated answer quality
